notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
easyPrerequisites: Ley Weaver and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Ley Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
